name: Barycentric Thick Endpoint Calculation
definition: Calculates the near (f) and far (b) endpoints of the 'thick line' (the intersection of the line of sight with the tetrahedron volume) using barycentric coordinates t of the x-ray source s with respect to the tetrahedron T. This avoids projecting vertices to the image plane.
summary: Barycentric Thick Endpoint Calculation determines ray-tetrahedron intersection endpoints using source barycentric coordinates, avoiding view-dependent projections for efficient, transform-independent volume rendering.
